snippet.title: I Almost Lost My Own Game | Tearable Choices developer solo run
snippet.description:
One of the developers plays a full box of Tearable Choices, our pack-ripping roguelike. Row 5 looked lost by 697 Hype, a slab came back from grading at the last second, and Row 6 ended at 67,103 Hype against a 31,300 quota. Along the way: how a run works, the card shop, Slabworks grading, builds, and the mistakes you will make too.

Tearable Choices is a roguelike about ripping booster packs. Pick a pack, rip it, swap cards into patterns (pairs, trios, quads, monochrome), then score the pack. Keep the best pulls in your binder, send them to Slabworks for a grade, sell the rest, and beat the quota on every row of the box. Heat, trends and debuffs change every row.

A demo is on the way. Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5125720/Tearable_Choices/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=dev_video&utm_campaign=dev_playthrough_1

Chapters
0:00 Cold open
0:37 Row 2: how a run works (patterns, swaps, quota)
1:40 The Card Shop: upgrades, supplies, singles
2:21 Slabworks: grading your pulls
3:27 Builds: there's a strategy for everything
4:45 Row 5: the mistake
6:21 Row 6: 31,300 to beat
9:45 Box cleared, vault picks, and what's next (demo, wishlist, roadmap)

Coming up
- Weekly competitions
- New pens, sleeves and playmats
- Multiplayer

Footage is from an in-development build (v0.25.1). Numbers, cards and art may change.

Follow development: https://discord.com/invite/WWUMFsgwC8
